result.label: feature
result.what_to_change: Persist the user's chosen export format (e.g., in localStorage) and read it back as the default instead of hardcoding defaultFormat = "csv", so the <select> remembers the last format used across visits.
result.evidence: ExportButton.tsx defines `export function ExportButton({ reportId, defaultFormat = "csv" }: ExportButtonProps)` with local component state `useState<ExportFormat>(defaultFormat)` that is never persisted anywhere (no localStorage/sessionStorage usage for the format), so the dropdown always resets to CSV on reload, matching the reporter's complaint.

not_searched: other components that might render ExportButton with a defaultFormat prop (e.g. report page wrappers)
